name: 1fi-project
description: 1Fi Application - React frontend with Node.js, Express and MongoDB backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.render-build: npm install --omit=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: Ranveer Bhati
